title: Frontend residuals - page upgrades (268), severity bar (264), chip B (266), in-app dialog (D6)
derived_from: Rulings posted 2026-11-18 under developer full-access grant: maturity_soon=teal (#263 comment), outlook=Option B chip-only (#265 comment), sweep per locked design (#267 comment); D6 in-app dialog confirmed with the design approval (frontend_component_upgrade_residuals_v1.html locked as 968cd7a). Documentation only, zero new decisions beyond those rulings.

requirements.text: The Search page SHALL use the upgraded component set: page-title heading (no body h1), labelled 48px search input per D3, result rows where expected yield is the row's largest number with the D5 rating chip, a 20px non-red status line, and an empty state with heading + one line + one primary action.

acceptance_criteria.then: the heading is a page-title (no body h1 pattern) and the search field is a 48px input with a visible label
expected yield is visually the largest number in each row and the rating chip follows the D5 band colours
an empty state shows a heading, one line of guidance and one primary button

requirements.text: The portfolio detail page SHALL present the company name as the page title with the ISIN as its muted subtitle, instead of a body h1 carrying the company name.

acceptance_criteria.then: the company name is the page-title and the ISIN appears as the muted subtitle, with no body h1

requirements.text: The monthly print page SHALL load the shared theme.css so its palette matches every other page, while keeping its standalone print layout.

acceptance_criteria.then: theme.css is linked and the page uses the shared tokens (accent, text, border); the print-specific layout structure is unchanged

requirements.text: The swept pages (search, portfolio_detail, monthly_print, payment_edit, payout, grid, share) SHALL use the D4 wording table: legacy strings such as 'Fetch details', 'Est. Yield' and 'Candidates' SHALL NOT appear.

acceptance_criteria.then: zero occurrences of the legacy strings 'Fetch details', 'Est. Yield', 'Candidates'
D4 wordings appear in their place (Fetch bond details, Expected yield, Watchlist as applicable)

requirements.text: All five alert severities SHALL render a 4px left severity bar: danger=red, due_today=amber, warn=amber, reminder=blue, maturity_soon=teal (light #0f766e on #f0fdfa, dark #5eead4 on #042f2e) via a new .sev-maturity_soon class plus the two teal tokens in theme.css.

acceptance_criteria.given: an alert row with severity maturity_soon
acceptance_criteria.then: it carries a 4px left bar in the teal token colours in both light and dark themes

acceptance_criteria.given: each of the five emitted severities
acceptance_criteria.then: each has a distinct documented bar rule; no severity renders bar-less
exactly the two teal tokens and one sev-maturity_soon rule were added; no other token changed

requirements.text: The rating chip SHALL show the grade only in the D5 bands (AAA..AA- green, A+..A- blue, BBB+ and below amber, not rated grey, never red) with NO outlook word or arrow markup (Option B ruling, #265).

acceptance_criteria.then: only the grade text renders - no outlook arrow characters or outlook spans exist in the templates
band colours match D5 exactly and none uses red

requirements.text: Browser window.confirm() SHALL be replaced by one in-app confirm dialog component (D6 confirmed): title states the action, body states the consequence in one sentence, the right button repeats the verb, Cancel is a text button, destructive actions use the danger fill and ordinary actions the primary fill - identical on web and Android.

acceptance_criteria.given: the user triggers either confirmed action
acceptance_criteria.then: it shows title=action + one-sentence consequence + verb-labelled primary + Cancel text; dismissing changes nothing
the original action proceeds exactly as with the old confirm() (same request, same result)

requirements.text: Frozen-contract guard: page layout, breakpoints, navigation (bottom tabs) and every existing theme token SHALL remain unchanged; theme.css changes are limited to the RS-05 additions.

acceptance_criteria.then: no template layout/nav structure changed and theme.css contains only the two teal tokens plus the sev-maturity_soon rule as additions

prd_items.statement: Search page gets the upgraded component set with yield-first rows and a real empty state.
Portfolio detail uses page-title company + ISIN subtitle instead of a body h1.
Monthly print links theme.css; layout stays standalone.
D4 wording table applied across the seven swept templates; legacy strings removed.
Five severity bars including the new teal maturity_soon rule.
Chip shows grade only - no outlook arrows (Option B).
One in-app confirm dialog replaces both window.confirm() call sites.
prd_items.decision_id: discussion #261 D6 confirmed with design approval 2026-11-18

prd_items.statement: Layout, nav and existing tokens frozen; theme.css delta limited to RS-05.
prd_items.decision_id: discussion #261 D1 + developer 'current theme design is okay' 2026-11-18

test_cases.title: Search page upgraded surface
test_cases.steps: 1. GET /search. 2. Assert page-title + labelled 48px input. 3. Seed results, assert yield-largest + D5 chip. 4. Query with no matches, assert empty state trio.
test_cases.expected: All four assertions hold in light and dark classes

test_cases.title: Portfolio detail title treatment
test_cases.steps: 1. GET a position detail page. 2. Assert company is page-title, ISIN muted subtitle, no body h1.
test_cases.expected: Title pattern applied, no body h1

test_cases.title: Print page uses shared theme
test_cases.steps: 1. GET /print (monthly). 2. Assert theme.css link present and token usage; assert print layout markers unchanged.

test_cases.title: Legacy wording removed from seven templates
test_cases.steps: 1. Render/grep each of the seven templates. 2. Assert zero 'Fetch details', 'Est. Yield', 'Candidates'. 3. Assert D4 replacements present where applicable.
test_cases.expected: No legacy strings; D4 strings present

test_cases.title: Five severity bars incl maturity_soon teal
test_cases.steps: 1. Render one alert per severity. 2. Assert 4px left bar per rule. 3. Assert sev-maturity_soon uses the teal tokens in light AND dark. 4. Assert theme.css delta is exactly 2 tokens + 1 rule.
test_cases.expected: Five of five bared; teal exact; delta exact

test_cases.title: Rating chip grade-only
test_cases.steps: 1. Render chips across bands. 2. Assert text is grade-only (no arrow/outlook markup). 3. Assert band colours; none red.

test_cases.title: In-app dialog replaces both confirms
test_cases.steps: 1. Grep portfolio.html + portfolio_detail.html for window.confirm( -> 0. 2. Trigger each action, assert dialog contents (title, sentence, verb button, Cancel text). 3. Cancel -> no request. 4. Confirm -> same request/result as before.
test_cases.expected: Zero confirms; dialog contract holds; behavior parity

test_cases.title: Frozen contract guard
test_cases.steps: 1. Diff review + theme.css token diff. 2. Assert only RS-05 additions. 3. Assert nav markup (bottom-tabs) untouched in scoped templates.

changelog.note: First suite: RS-01..RS-08 from the three rulings posted today (#263 teal, #265 Option B, #267 sweep scope) plus D6 confirmed with the locked residuals design (968cd7a). 8 requirements, 16 ACs, 8 test cases, full RTM bindings.
